topic: What if you could see a death count above everyone's head showing their remaining days?
title: WHAT IF YOU COULD SEE
EVERYONE'S DEATH COUNT?

power.rule: a glowing number above every head, counting down their remaining days
power.look: a soft red counter above each head, the digits fading in on focus

script.text: You check the stranger's timer: 12403. You tip extra.
You scan the subway car. Mother: 42. Baby: 19801. You give up your seat.
You stare at your sister across the table. Her timer blinks 14. You haven't spoken in three years.
What if you could see a death count above everyone's head?

script.beat: 4 the turn: the hidden rule, one real fact
script.text: One catch: the timer counts whoever you're thinking of — right now. That's real.

science.claim: The timer reads the person you're thinking about, not you.
science.working: Narrative rule, not a scientific claim. The twist reframes the power from self-focused to other-focused, making every glance a choice about whose time you're witnessing.
